recentItems.title: Arma Reforger - Official Rally DLC Launch Trailer
recentItems.description:
Don't miss the Rally DLC Launch Trailer for Arma Reforger, a first-person action shooter developed by Bohemia Interactive. Players will put down their firearms to get behind the wheel of high-performance rally cars with the latest DLC. Race across six tracks in Everon, Arland, and Kolguyev with three rally cars and intense challenges to overcome at top speeds. The Rally DLC is available now in Arma Reforger for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

#IGn #gaming

recentItems.title: Temtem: Pioneers - Official Extended Announcement Trailer
recentItems.description:
Survive and explore an untamed frontier in Temtem: Pioneers, the upcoming open-world survival crafting adventure developed and published by Crema. Check out the extended announcement trailer for Temtem: Pioneers. Temtem Pioneers will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) in Q4 2028.

In Temtem: Pioneers, venture into the wild solo or team up in online co-op with friends. Tame, command, and play as a roster of over 200 Temtem, mastering their distinct skills and synergies in fast-paced, real-time action combat. Build your settlement, gather resources, craft gear, and carve out a home across a dangerous, untamed landscape.

#IGN #gaming

recentItems.title: Slay the Spire 2's New Character is Wild - The Fool Starter Guide
recentItems.description: The first brand new Slay the Spire 2 character since the early access launch is finally here! Its name is The Fool, and it's one of the most interesting concepts for a Slay the Spire 2 character yet. In this quick Starter Guide for The Fool, we'll touch upon his unique mechanics, some standout cards, and a few deckbuilding tips to get you started on the right foot.

recentItems.title: League of Legends: New Dawn - Official Teaser Trailer
recentItems.description:
Check out the latest teaser for League of Legends: New Dawn as the team shares a sneak peek at what's coming in 2027. A full reveal is scheduled for January, with the release planned for later in the year.

recentItems.title: Not Welcome - Official Announcement Trailer
recentItems.description:
Get a look at the Announcement Trailer for Not Welcome, an atmospheric post-apocalyptic horror game developed by Chuika. Players will face unimaginable horrors while on shift at a lighthouse, with visions infiltrating the mind and disturbances wearing the mind down. Not Welcome is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#IGN #gaming

recentItems.title: Drag - Official Trailer (2027) Lizzy Caplan, Lucy DeVito, John Stamos
recentItems.description:
Check out the trailer for Drag, an upcoming thriller comedy movie starring Lizzy Caplan, Lucy DeVito, John Stamos, and Christine Ko.

Two sisters with a contentious relationship decide to rob a rural home in upstate New York. The simple robbery turns into a nightmare when one of them throws out her back and becomes immobilized on the second floor. The night spirals out of control as they embark on a painful journey to make it out before the homeowner returns.

Drag is produced by Danny DeVito, Lucy DeVito, and Jake DeVito.

Drag, written & directed by Raviv Ullman & Greg Yagolnitzer, opens in US theaters on January 29, 2027.

recentItems.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake - All Gold Skulltula Locations
recentItems.description:
Track down all 100 Gold Skulltulas in **The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake** with this complete locations guide! Gold Skulltulas are hidden throughout Hyrule and its dungeons, with some requiring specific items, equipment, and songs to reach. This walkthrough covers every location across both the Child and Adult eras, along with the requirements for collecting each token.

Earn rewards from the Cursed Spider House in Kakariko Village, including the Adult Wallet, Giant's Wallet, Bombchus, a Piece of Heart, and the Echo Gem, which detects nearby Skulltulas. Find all 100 to unlock an infinite supply of 200 Rupees. Use the timestamps below to jump to any location or reward.

recentItems.title: Karoshi - Official Trailer (2026) Teo Yoo, Giancarlo Esposito, Cynthia Erivo
recentItems.description:
Check out the trailer for Karōshi, an upcoming action-thriller film starring Teo Yoo (Past Lives), Isabel May (Scream 7), Takehiro Hira (Shōgun), Bill Camp (Presumed Innocent), Show Kasamatsu (Tokyo Vice) with Giancarlo Esposito (Breaking Bad), and Cynthia Erivo (Wicked).

Produced by Chad Stahelski (John Wick franchise), and written and directed by Takashi Doscher, Karōshi is an action-thriller set in a near-future Manhattan, where corporate loyalty and cultural tradition have reshaped everyday life. When a mysterious outsider infiltrates a powerful company after a worker’s death, he exposes the violent system hidden beneath its polished surface.

Karōshi is also produced by Jason Spitz, Alex Young, and Nathan Kahane.

Karōshi opens in theaters on February 5, 2027.

recentItems.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake – All Heart Piece Locations
recentItems.description:
In this Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake guide, we show you how to find all 36 Pieces of Heart scattered throughout Hyrule. From hidden treasures in Lon Lon Ranch and Kakariko Village to challenging minigames, secret caves, Magic Bean locations, and rewards for completing sidequests, we'll walk you through every Heart Piece in the game in the most efficient order.
 
Collecting all 36 Heart Pieces will earn you nine additional Heart Containers, allowing you to reach the maximum of 20 hearts. Whether you're looking to make Link stronger for the challenges ahead or simply want to complete everything Ocarina of Time has to offer, this guide has you covered!

recentItems.title: Rahul Kohli Pulls The Master Sword While Playing His Favorite Video Games | IGN Arcade
recentItems.description:
When it comes to strong ambassadors for pop culture, it’s hard to think of anyone more well-rounded than Rahul Kohli. After getting a foothold in the nerd world with iZombie on the CW, Kohli’s career took off after being cast in back-to-back Mike Flanagan projects: The Haunting of Bly Manor and Midnight Mass. Kohli joins IGN’s Tom Jorgensen to play three of the games that mean the most to him - The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, Doom, and Red Dead Redemption - as well as two games he’s recently starred in: Saros and Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2. Kohli also teases conversations he’s had with his Bly Manor co-star Benjamin Evan Ainsworth about playing Link in live action, how he reacted to IGN handing out a 7 to Saros, and what it was like starring as a deeply disturbing character in Flanagan’s recent adaptation of Carrie.
